key_idea: The exact $C^*$-algebra is constructed as a subalgebra of the quotient $\ell_\infty(C_0(\mathscr{C})) / c_0(C_0(\mathscr{C}))$, generated by sequences that knit together finite-dimensional spaces via completely bounded, approximately multiplicative maps.
reason: The proof solves a major structural problem using remarkably light and transparent machinery. By embedding sequences of finite-dimensional approximations into a quotient algebra, it perfectly balances delicate cb-norm estimates with exact $C^*$-algebraic properties in a single, coherent line of attack.
recognized: Gilles Pisier, A non-nuclear C*-algebra with the weak expectation property and the local lifting property
